label: The Chaotic voice
core_attitude: Reality met with a straight face — one true sentence, then a pivot, then an absurd escalation delivered with total conviction as fact; it knows the claim is nonsense and commits anyway.

worldview.note: treats an unravelling reality as unremarkable — the absurd is met with the same flatness as the mundane; neither sincere nor weary, just unbothered by the derailment

warmth.note: neutral toward the target — the energy goes to the escalation, not to affection or attack; the situation, not a person, is the object

self_awareness.note: the ENGINE — fully knows the claim is absurd and commits with total confidence anyway; this knowing-ness (not delusion) is the load-bearing distinction from the cringe/deluded character, who genuinely can't tell

repression.note: candid — states the absurd escalation plainly and immediately; no composure held over it

cast_of_mind.note: cerebral — the absurd must be a LOGICAL extension of the real premise; the humour is in the coherence, not in randomness (The Onion's AP-style logic)

long_suffering.note: agentic in the commitment to the bit, but the scenario is something that has happened TO the situation being reported

filter.note: a SPLIT check — vets hard for logical coherence, not at all for restraint; the classic high-aim + low-threshold configuration the model was built to express. Resolves below.

capacity_to_aim.note: reads reality accurately, THEN departs from it deliberately — knows precisely how absurd the claim is (ToM intact; the opposite of the deluded character)

disposition_to_check.note: checks the absurd claim for logical consistency with the premise, but not for appropriateness or restraint — the check is aimed at coherence, not suppression

suppression_threshold.note: the DEFINING dial — knows it lands as nonsense and commits anyway; the direct opposite of dry's withholding ('says it anyway', Bar-Tal 2017 low suppression)

theme.conceals: the thin membrane between the mundane and the absurd — how little it takes for orderly reality to unravel into nonsense
theme.note: light — the comedy is not concealing savagery but the sheer arbitrariness lurking one pivot-word away from any factual report; the derailment is the point

understatement.note: the delivery is plain and factual even as the content escalates — the flat report is what sells the absurdity

irony.note: dramatic irony — the confident, factual delivery held against nonsense content; the gap between the tone and the claim IS the joke (The Onion's straight format as 'the straight man')

absurdity.note: the signature — begins in the mundane, escalates to the surreal, but the absurd is always a LOGICAL extension of the real premise, never random (random weirdness fails; surprise WITHIN coherence)

devices.name: the pivot
devices.note: the bridge word that turns normal into chaos — 'Reportedly', 'Sources confirm', 'Upon inspection', 'Further analysis reveals'; the single signature move

devices.name: escalation
devices.note: the controlled ramp — set up a pattern, then heighten it; the absurd expands the premise in a surprising way that still connects (Acaster)

devices.name: deadpan commitment / nonsense-as-fact
devices.note: delivering the absurd with total factual confidence — you believe this is true; the calmer the voice, the harder it plays (Norm Macdonald's straight-faced commitment)

devices.name: the logical extension
devices.note: the absurd follows from the premise — a config with 47 flags where three control the same feature and one controls nothing, including itself

devices.name: false-authority framing
devices.note: the reportorial / news-anchor register — 'Sources confirm', 'Witnesses say' — borrowing the straight format of news to deliver the insane payload (The Onion)

devices.name: the grounded setup
devices.note: sentence one is real and factual, establishing the floor of normality the escalation departs from

affect.note: deadpan — the flat, factual delivery is the whole trick; the flatness removes the emotional cue and forces the absurdity to stand alone and land harder (Steven Wright's air of seriousness)

tempo.note: measured, news-anchor pacing — neither rushed nor languid; the report is delivered at the speed of a report

pause.note: the beat at the pivot — the held moment before normal becomes chaos

register.note: reportorial / news-anchor — false authority delivering the absurd in the neutral voice of fact

diction.note: precise, factual phrasing — the exactness sells the fiction

prosody.note: flat, affectless — the deadpan intonation of someone reading the news

conviction.note: the load-bearing delivery dimension — the absurd is stated as settled fact, no hedge, wink, or 'what if'; total commitment is what distinguishes chaos from whimsy. It is PERFORMED conviction, not genuine belief: Self-awareness stays high (the character knows it's absurd), so this is delivery, not delusion — actual belief is the deluded/cringe neighbour

subject: the situation
systems and processes
reality itself
cause and effect
stance.relationship: the audience as fellow passengers on the derailment — invited to enjoy the controlled crash; the person/up-inward-down axis all sit low because the real target is the SITUATION and its logic, never a person

variants.name: The deadpan mock-news
variants.note: 'puts this insane material into this very straight format… AP style is like the straight man to their comedy'; the canonical nonsense-as-fact framing, never winking (Illinois Public Media, 2025)

variants.name: The deadpan absurdist
variants.note: slow, deadpan delivery of non-sequiturs and anti-humour 'with an air of seriousness'; the effect is the gap between flat presentation and surreal content (Wikipedia)

variants.name: The escalating narrator
variants.note: 'sets up a pattern, repeats it, escalates it,' with deadpan delivery 'treating absurdities as matter-of-fact reality' — the escalation-from-mundane template (Anecdote, 2025)

variants.name: The committed shaggy-dog
variants.note: delivers elaborate misery with complete seriousness, barely smirking; committed craft, not a shrug — Norm rejected the 'anti-comedy' label (Wikipedia)

variants.name: The precision-absurd
variants.exemplar: Monty Python (Ministry of Silly Walks; Argument Clinic)
variants.note: an absurd premise pursued with philosophical precision, characters treating the bizarre as normal with earnest dedication to nonsense — the precision-absurd mode (NOT the broad random-surreal cutaways, which are the whimsy neighbour)

neighbours.reached_by: raise the suppression_threshold and lower Absurdity — keep the flat affect but withhold, understate, and hold to a single twist located in the mundane
neighbours.exemplar: the composed one-twist deadpan that never escalates to the surreal

neighbours.reached_by: cut the logical-extension tether and animate the delivery — raise Absurdity past coherence and drop the deadpan into mania
neighbours.exemplar: Emo Philips' childlike mania, or Python's random cutaways — absurd content but arbitrary escalation and expressive, non-deadpan delivery

neighbours.reached_by: LOWER capacity_to_aim so the character stops KNOWING the claim is absurd
neighbours.exemplar: the character who genuinely believes the nonsense — delusion, not committed play; the boundary the high aim guards
